title: Quantifiers & Element Operators
description: Learn to evaluate conditions with All, Any, Contains, and retrieve specific elements with ElementAt, First, Last, Single.
longDescription: This module covers quantifier and element operators in LINQ. You'll learn to evaluate conditions across collections and retrieve specific elements by position or condition.
whatYouLearn: Evaluate conditions with All and Any
Check for element existence with Contains
Retrieve elements by index with ElementAt
Get first elements with First and FirstOrDefault
Get last elements with Last and LastOrDefault
Get single elements with Single and SingleOrDefault
